papers.title: How Murky Before a VLM Knows It Cannot See? Accuracy, Confidence and Abstention on a Physical Visibility Axis
papers.abstract: Robustness studies of vision-language models (VLMs) grade degradation on nominal severity scales ("level 1-5") that carry no physical units, and they rarely ask whether a model's confidence follows the loss of visibility. We measure accuracy, internal (token-probability) confidence, verbalized confidence and an explicit abstain option on a visibility axis in metres: fog follows the Koschmieder model, an underwater arm scales the absorption spectrum of pure water, both are applied with a monocular metric depth map, and the visibility range V is swept over eight log-spaced levels from 250 m to 1.95 m. On 1000 COCO scenes and five small open VLMs (2-5 B parameters), accuracy on a boxed-object identification task falls from near its clean value to chance within a narrow band (half-way visibility V_acc of 12.1-15.9 m in fog and 20.5-38.6 m under water) while, for the four models that are confident on clean images, the confidence stays high: at V=1.95 m in fog their accuracy is at chance but their mean internal confidence is 0.68-0.84 and their verbalized confidence 0.61-1.00, a blind-spot width W=log10(V_acc/V_aware) of at least 0.79 decades, i.e. a factor of 6.2 in visibility. The remaining model is under-confident throughout and its internal confidence follows accuracy. An explicit abstain option follows accuracy when it names the reason (W from -0.21 to -0.06 in fog) but, for one model, lags with a generic "I don't know" (W up to 0.18). ImageNet-C fog severities 1-5 correspond to only 55-110 m of physical visibility, outside the failure band, and leave the accuracy of the models within 5 percentage points of its clean value. Blank-image and shuffled-image controls, a prior-matched answer set and a 200-image pilot that preceded the study are reported. Findings are descriptive: one draw of 1000 images, depth of assumed scale, and models of 2-5 B parameters.

papers.title_zh: 视觉语言模型在多模糊时才意识到自己看不见？物理可见度轴上的准确率、置信度与弃答行为
papers.summary_cn: 论文抛弃无物理单位的“level 1-5”退化刻度，改在以米为单位的可见度轴上评测小规模开源 VLM：雾按 Koschmieder 模型生成，水下场景按纯水吸收光谱缩放，两者都借助单目度量深度图施加，可见度 V 取 250 m 到 1.95 m 之间八个对数间隔等级。在 1000 张 COCO 场景和 5 个 2-5B 参数的开源 VLM 上做框选目标识别，准确率在很窄的可见度区间内从接近干净图像水平跌到随机猜测，雾中的半程可见度 V_acc 为 12.1-15.9 m，水下为 20.5-38.6 m。在雾中 V=1.95 m 时准确率已等同随机，但四个原本对干净图像自信的模型内部 token 概率置信度仍为 0.68-0.84、语言化置信度为 0.61-1.00，盲区宽度 W=log10(V_acc/V_aware) 至少 0.79 个数量级（可见度相差 6.2 倍）。显式弃答只有在要求模型说明理由时才跟随准确率变化（雾中 W 为 -0.21 到 -0.06），仅给泛化“我不知道”的模型则滞后（W 最高 0.18）。
innovations: 提出以物理可见度为轴、八个对数间隔等级（250 m 至 1.95 m）的评测协议，用 Koschmieder 雾模型与按纯水吸收谱缩放的水下退化模型配合单目度量深度图施加退化，替代无物理单位的标称严重度刻度。
定义盲区宽度 W=log10(V_acc/V_aware) 来量化“准确率已崩溃、置信度仍很高”的错位程度，并同时测量内部 token 概率置信度、语言化置信度与显式弃答三条通道：四个模型在雾中 V=1.95 m 时准确率达随机水平，内部置信度仍有 0.68-0.84，W 至少 0.79 个数量级。
发现弃答是否有效取决于是否要求给出理由：带理由的弃答在雾中 W 为 -0.21 到 -0.06，能紧跟准确率；而泛化“我不知道”式弃答滞后，某模型 W 高达 0.18。
通过 ImageNet-C 刻度反查发现其雾严重度 1-5 实际只对应 55-110 m 物理可见度，落在失效带之外，模型准确率与干净图像相差不超过 5 个百分点，说明该常用基准无法暴露此类失效；另报告空白图与打乱图对照、先验匹配答案集及 200 图预实验。
识别出一个全程欠自信的模型作为反例：其内部置信度随准确率同步下降，说明高置信盲区并非所有小模型共有，与训练/校准方式有关。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向雾天、水下等低可见度条件下的安全相关 VLM 部署（如监控与无人平台感知），用于判断模型何时应当弃答而不是继续给出高置信错误答案，并为鲁棒性基准选择物理可解释的退化刻度提供依据。

papers.title: Stealthy Poisoning Attacks via Reused KV Cache of Reasoning
papers.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) systems reuse key-value (KV) caches to accelerate inference. Recent work has shown that reusing KV caches from reasoning traces can also improve task performance, similar to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We demonstrate that this form of KV cache reuse introduces new poisoning vulnerabilities. We propose R$^2$ECAP (Reused Reasoning-Cache Poisoning), a black-box attack that plants poisoned reasoning traces solely through interactions with a system's chat interface. R$^2$ECAP constructs two traces: a preceding trace that steers the model toward an adversarial target and a retained trace that carries this target. Because the retained trace is generated conditioned on the preceding trace, its KV cache preserves residual adversarial influence, even after the preceding trace and its cache entries are discarded. We evaluate R$^2$ECAP on three open-weight LLMs and three datasets. R$^2$ECAP achieves up to 79% attack success rate (ASR) and outperforms HijackKV, a state-of-the-art white-box KV poisoning attack, in 8 of 9 resource-constrained settings. It also achieves 46% ASR in a realistic reasoning-trace retrieval system. Finally, R$^2$ECAP remains stealthy, with only 1% of its retained responses detected by a popular prompt injection detector.

papers.title_zh: 通过复用推理过程 KV Cache 实施的隐蔽投毒攻击
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究 LLM 系统复用推理轨迹 KV cache（类似 RAG 的推理缓存复用）所引入的新型投毒攻击面，提出黑盒攻击方法 R²ECAP（Reused Reasoning-Cache Poisoning）。该方法仅通过系统聊天接口植入有害推理轨迹：先构造一条“前置轨迹”把模型导向攻击目标，再生成一条“保留轨迹”承载该目标；由于保留轨迹是在前置轨迹条件下生成的，其 KV cache 会残留对抗性影响，即使前置轨迹及其 cache 条目随后被丢弃，这一影响依然存在。作者在 3 个开源权重 LLM 与 3 个数据集上评估，R²ECAP 最高达到 79% 攻击成功率，在 9 个资源受限设置中有 8 个优于白盒 KV 投毒方法 HijackKV，并在真实的推理轨迹检索系统中取得 46% ASR。
innovations: 首次把“推理轨迹 KV cache 复用”识别为新的投毒攻击面，将原本用于推理加速与性能增强的缓存复用机制重新定义为安全威胁模型。
提出双轨迹构造机制 R²ECAP：前置轨迹负责把模型引导至对抗目标，保留轨迹通过条件化生成继承并留存该目标，使攻击在前置轨迹与对应 cache 条目被丢弃后仍然有效。
攻击为纯黑盒，仅依赖聊天接口交互，无需访问模型权重或 KV cache，并在 8/9 个资源受限设置下超过白盒方法 HijackKV。
在 3 个开源 LLM 和 3 个数据集上验证，最高 79% ASR、真实检索系统 46% ASR，且仅 1% 的保留回复被主流提示注入检测器识别，量化了攻击的隐蔽性。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向采用推理轨迹 KV cache 复用来加速推理或多轮增强的 LLM 服务（如带推理缓存复用的对话系统、推理轨迹检索式 RAG 系统）：说明开放聊天接口可被远端用户用于投毒并劫持输出，需要在服务侧评估缓存复用策略的安全风险并设计检测与防御。

papers.title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

papers.title_zh: DLite：面向 Agentic AI 的无历史投机解码
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对 agentic 负载下投机解码草稿模型失效的问题：长且持续演化的上下文与频繁多轮交互使现有草稿模型的接受长度最多下降 80%，而保留历史 KV cache 又会带来显著系统开销。作者指出“不断增长的历史上下文”是这两类问题的共同根源，提出无历史（history-free）投机解码框架 DLite，直接复用目标模型的上下文隐状态做局部投机预测，把原本复杂的上下文建模问题转化为局部简单预测，并用轻量级顺序头以低开销恢复块内因果依赖，配合定制的两阶段训练策略训练该异构无历史架构。在通用、长上下文与 agentic 负载上，DLite 取得 2–6 的接受长度，相比当前最优方法 DSpark 最高提升 70%。
innovations: 将 agentic 场景下草稿模型接受长度退化的根因定位为持续增长的历史上下文，并据此提出无历史投机解码范式，放弃显式维护历史 KV cache 以消除其系统开销。
直接复用目标模型已有的上下文隐状态进行局部投机预测，把随上下文增长的复杂建模问题降维为局部简单预测，同时保持草稿质量。
引入轻量级顺序头（sequential head），以低开销恢复块内 token 的因果依赖，弥补无历史预测丢失的顺序信息。
设计两阶段训练策略以有效训练异构无历史架构；实验中量化了现有草稿模型最高 80% 的接受长度退化，并在通用、长上下文与 agentic 负载上取得 2–6 接受长度、相对 DSpark 最高 70% 的提升。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于多轮对话、工具调用等上下文持续增长的 Agent 推理服务与长上下文 LLM 在线部署，在不显式维护历史 KV cache 的前提下降低缓存开销并提升解码吞吐与延迟表现，可替代依赖历史 KV cache 的传统投机解码方案。

papers.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are commonly evaluated against fixed task specifications, but users may omit requirements, add constraints, or require approval before consequential actions. Completing the benchmark instruction does not guarantee serving the person who asked. We introduce PersonaCUABench, which holds 74 tasks across 11 domains fixed and varies only who asks. A persona agent, playing one of 44 personas in four groups, rewrites each instruction in that user's own words and answers the CUA's questions, while the CUA sees only the dialogue, never the profile or the original instruction. Across nine backbones (3,330 runs), mean task completion falls by 36% relative to the original requests. The losses have two sources: in 59.9% of cells that lose points, the agent engages with what the user asked for and still gets it wrong, and 11.2% are stops the user requested that the checker scores as failures. Even when a persona request is fully completed, the user gives the top satisfaction rating in only 62.7% of cells, against 84.1% for the original requests. CUAs should therefore be evaluated not only on task completion but also on whether they meet the requirements and constraints users express. Code: this https URL . Project page: this https URL

papers.title_zh: PersonaCUABench：面向服务多元用户画像的计算机使用智能体基准测试
papers.summary_cn: PersonaCUABench 针对计算机使用智能体（CUA）评测中“任务固定、用户单一”的缺口，固定 74 个任务横跨 11 个领域，只改变“谁来提问”：由 persona agent 扮演四组共 44 个用户画像之一，用该用户自己的措辞改写指令并实时回答 CUA 的追问，而 CUA 只能看到对话内容，看不到画像与原始指令。在九个基座模型、共 3,330 次运行中，平均任务完成率相对原始请求下降 36%；在失分单元里有 59.9% 属于智能体确实围绕用户所问去执行但仍做错，另有 11.2% 是用户主动叫停却被检查器判为失败。即便画像请求被完整完成，用户给出最高满意度的比例也只有 62.7%，而原始请求达到 84.1%。
innovations: 构建 PersonaCUABench 受控评测范式：74 个任务 × 11 个领域保持不变，仅通过 44 个画像（分四组）改变提问者，把“用户画像”与“任务规格”两个变量解耦。
设计 persona agent 双角色机制：既用目标用户的口吻改写指令，又在交互中代答 CUA 的澄清问题，同时向 CUA 屏蔽画像与原始指令，迫使其仅凭对话推断隐含需求与约束。
在 9 个基座模型、3,330 次运行上给出失分归因：59.9% 为“理解对了但执行错”，11.2% 为用户要求停止而被判失败，量化出完成率指标对停止意图的系统性误判。
引入用户满意度维度，发现任务完整完成时最高满意度仅 62.7%（原始请求 84.1%），证明“完成任务”不等于“服务好人”，暴露完成率作为唯一指标的盲区。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于评估面向真实终端用户的浏览器/桌面操作智能体、办公自动化与跨应用助手。尤其适合用户表达含糊、会追加约束或在敏感操作前要求确认的业务流程，用于判断智能体能否理解并遵守用户实际表达的需求边界。

papers.title: Wait for It: A Component-Level Analysis of Latency Feedback Mechanisms for LLM Agents in VR
papers.abstract: Delays in AI responses pose a significant challenge to immersive Virtual Reality experiences. While previous research demonstrates that feedback can reduce the perception of waiting, we lack understanding of which types work best and why. We conducted a within-subjects study with 18 participants to systematically compare three isolated feedback approaches during VR agent interactions: verbal fillers (e.g., um..., hmm...), visual indicators (loading spinners), and embodied gestures (thinking animations). Our results revealed that embodied gestures significantly outperformed visual loading indicators across multiple dimensions, making agents feel more lifelike and socially present. Interestingly, explicit visual feedback like loading spinners actually degraded perceived humanness and broke immersion by forcing users to shift from social to technical mental models. These findings suggest that natural, behavior-based feedback maintains the illusion of conversing with a thinking entity, while technical indicators expose the computational substrate. We present empirically-grounded design guidelines for creating more engaging AI-powered VR agents.

papers.title_zh: 再等一下：VR 中 LLM 智能体延迟反馈机制的组件级分析
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对 VR 中 LLM 智能体响应延迟破坏沉浸感的问题，开展 18 人被试内（within-subjects）实验，把三种相互隔离的反馈方式逐一对比：语言填充词（如“嗯…”“唔…”）、视觉指示器（加载转圈）、具身手势（思考动画）。结果显示具身手势在多个维度显著优于视觉加载指示器，使智能体更显真实、更具社会临场感；而加载转圈这类显式视觉反馈反而降低拟人感并打断沉浸，因为它迫使用户从“社交心智模型”切换到“技术心智模型”。作者据此提炼出以自然行为化反馈维持“正在思考的对话者”错觉的设计准则。
innovations: 采用 18 人被试内实验设计，将语言填充词、视觉加载指示器、具身思考动画三种反馈机制单独隔离比较，而非打包评估，从而定位到具体组件的贡献。
发现具身手势型反馈在真实感（lifelike）与社会临场感（social presence）等多个维度显著优于视觉加载指示器。
给出反直觉结论：显式视觉反馈（loading spinner）会降低 perceived humanness 并破坏沉浸，其机制是触发用户从社交心智模型向技术心智模型迁移，从而暴露计算基底。
输出基于行为化自然反馈的实证设计准则，用于在延迟不可消除时维持“与思考中的实体对话”的错觉。

papers.title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: In a hierarchical multi-agent system, a Leader assigns tasks and subagents carry them out. Jointly training the Leader and the subagents is difficult because a final answer gives only indirect feedback to the subagents. An LLM judge can score the performance of the subagents, but these scores depend on the judge's own assessment of the quality of subagents' responses. We present MultiAgent-OPD, which combines on-policy distillation with reinforcement learning to jointly train a shared-parameter Leader-Searcher-Answerer team end to end. We first train a Teacher in a Searcher-Answerer workflow using answer correctness. During team training, the frozen Teacher scores student-generated search and summary tokens to provide local process supervision for the Searchers, while the Leader learns from team success and the Answerer from candidate correctness. Across seven datasets, the trained system reaches 38.68% macro avg@4, exceeding Prompted Critic by 4.06 percentage points and C-MAS + RL, the trained cascaded multiagent system, by 2.61 percentage points. The team also solves more questions within four attempts.

papers.title: Beyond the Answer: Student-Conditioned Trace Construction for Reasoning Distillation
papers.abstract: A reasoning trace can accompany a correct answer without providing effective supervision for a particular student. We study how to construct traces that improve learning beyond answer-only supervision by considering both their intermediate content and their accessibility to the target learner. We introduce ReDiST, a student-conditioned trace-construction and distillation framework for evidence-rich reasoning. Starting from the student's own attempts, ReDiST revises answer-correct drafts against the supplied evidence and repairs unsuccessful drafts with additional guidance from the verified answer. A frozen student-matched reader screens and ranks original and edited candidates using answer recovery and verified-answer probability, given the question, evidence, and candidate trace. We distill the selected targets while balancing trace and final-answer supervision with an auxiliary answer loss. Construction and selection occur offline, and inference uses only the distilled student. Experiments on question-answering benchmarks show that ReDiST can improve both source-task and cross-benchmark performance over answer-only, original-trace, and the evaluated trace-selection and rewriting baselines. Across supervision recipes, performance rankings can differ between source and transfer benchmarks, highlighting the importance of evaluating trace teaching utility across distributions.

papers.title_zh: 超越答案本身：面向推理蒸馏的学生条件化轨迹构建
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出，一条伴随正确答案的推理轨迹未必能为特定学生提供有效监督，因此提出 ReDiST——一个以学生自身尝试为起点的“学生条件化”轨迹构建与蒸馏框架。ReDiST 对答案正确的草稿依据给定证据进行修订，对失败草稿则借助已验证答案补充引导后修复；随后由一个冻结的、与学生能力匹配的 reader 模型在给定问题、证据和候选轨迹的条件下，用答案可恢复性和已验证答案概率对原始与编辑候选进行筛选排序。最终对选中目标做蒸馏，并用辅助答案损失平衡轨迹监督与最终答案监督；构建与选择均离线完成，推理阶段只用蒸馏后的学生模型。在问答基准上，ReDiST 相比仅答案监督、原始轨迹以及所对比的轨迹选择与改写基线，同时提升了源任务与跨基准表现。

引入冻结的学生匹配 reader 作为筛选器，以“答案可恢复性”和“已验证答案概率”两个指标对原始与编辑候选轨迹排序，实现轨迹教学效用的显式度量。
蒸馏目标同时包含轨迹损失与最终答案损失（辅助答案损失），在轨迹监督与答案监督之间做权衡，而非单纯模仿长推理链。

构建与选择全部离线执行，推理时仅部署蒸馏后的学生模型，不增加线上开销。

papers.title: Distill Until Divergence: Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Long-horizon interaction requires agents to make multiple decisions in a changing environment. Outcome-based GRPO lacks fine-grained guidance for intermediate decisions. Recent methods distill completed trajectories into reusable skills and use hindsight-conditioned OPD to provide dense token-level credit. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose \methodname{}, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors. The post-error suffix is optimized exclusively by GRPO, retaining outcome-based learning without extending potentially mismatched hindsight supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive task performance and support effective fine-grained credit allocation.

papers.title_zh: 蒸馏至发散：面向智能体强化学习的错误截断式事后蒸馏
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对长程交互智能体在基于结果（outcome-based）的 GRPO 训练中缺乏对中间决策细粒度指导的问题，指出现有“把完整轨迹蒸馏为可复用技能 + 事后条件 OPD”的做法存在一个关键错配：技能带来的概率偏移并不等于与奖励对齐的信用分配，尤其在某个错误动作改变了后续交互状态之后，以技能为条件的监督会与当前状态失配。为此作者提出错误截断式事后蒸馏方法，按轨迹最终成败与错误边界把两类互补的 hindsight 技能分流：Positive 技能刻画成功工作流，用于强化成功轨迹及错误发生前的决策；Negative 技能刻画失败特有的纠正方式，专门指向决定性错误。错误发生之后的轨迹后缀则完全交由 GRPO 优化，从而保留基于结果的学习，不把可能已错配的事后监督延伸过去。实验显示该方法在任务表现上具备竞争力，并支持有效的细粒度信用分配。
innovations: 提出按轨迹结果与错误边界对事后技能进行双向路由的机制：Positive 技能用于强化成功轨迹和错误前的决策，Negative 技能用于针对决定性错误，解决了技能诱导的概率偏移未必与奖励对齐的问题。
设计错误截断（error-truncated）的监督范围控制：错误之后的轨迹后缀只由 GRPO 优化，不再施加以技能为条件的 OPD 监督，避免在状态已被错误动作改变后继续使用失配的 hindsight 信号。
将技能蒸馏与结果驱动的强化学习在 token 级信用分配上互补结合，在长程、动态环境的多步决策中同时获得稠密监督与结果对齐性。
实验验证了在保持竞争性任务表现的同时实现更有效的细粒度信用分配，说明该分流与截断策略优于不加区分地延展事后蒸馏。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于需要多步决策、环境状态随动作持续变化的长程智能体强化学习训练，例如工具调用、交互式任务求解等场景；它解决的是中间步骤奖励稀疏、错误一旦发生便污染后续监督信号的训练难题。

papers.title: Enforcing Code Reasoning in Agentic Scaffold for More Effective Issue Resolution
papers.abstract: Reasoning is central to ReAct-based programming agents, yet whether and how they reason about code remains unclear. We study 7,955 issue-resolution trajectories from six single- and multi-agent scaffolds across four programming languages on SWE-bench-Verified, SWE-bench-Pro, and SWE-bench-Lite. We identify 12 forms of code reasoning in 66.95% of trajectories. Code reasoning is associated with higher resolution rates, and its intensity increases with task complexity. However, it remains largely unguided: agents may focus on surface-level symptoms during localization, fail to refine near-correct patches, overlook issue requirements, and generate tests with limited behavioral diversity. To address these limitations, we propose DeskCheck, an agentic scaffold that systematically guides code reasoning throughout repository-level issue resolution. DeskCheck simulates execution paths to localize root causes, simulates candidate patches to refine near-misses, audits patches against issue requirements, and reasons about corner-case inputs and expected outputs before generating tests. On 731 SWE-bench-Pro instances, DeskCheck improves resolution rates over mini-SWE-Agent and Claude Code by 6.29% to 10.53%, at an additional cost of $0.02-$0.28 per instance (average: $0.14). Per-phase analyses show higher method-level localization recall, more successful repairs of imprecisely localized issues, and better detection of missed corner cases in near-correct patches. Exact McNemar tests show statistically significant improvements across all subject LLMs (p < 10^-10), while repeated experiments support robustness to agent nondeterminism. These findings motivate systematic code reasoning as a means of improving programming agents.

papers.title: PRIME: Towards Verifiable Evidence-Grounded Reasoning in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents are used to check records against an organization's requirements, for example whether a vulnerability report is ready for investigation. Requirements often allow several ways to be met, such as a severity rating with a curator-reviewed advisory or a published advisory link. Agents fail by accepting a report after a required check has failed, or by settling for a weaker conclusion without trying another way that could still succeed. We introduce PRIME (Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence). Before checking, it fixes evidence routes specifying how each conclusion may be justified. A separate program records each check result and refuses any conclusion the results do not justify. It also points the agent to checks that could justify a stronger conclusion, or runs them itself. PRIME reports only conclusions authorized by its rules and ledger. With correct requirements, exact checks at known locations, and sufficient budget at stopping, completion reaches the strongest supported conclusion. On 480 public-record tasks, an agent shown the requirements reported unjustified conclusions on 26.7% of tasks, while PRIME reported none. Its directions and added checks raised the average score for justified conclusions from 30.1, with refusal alone, to the maximum of 59.2 out of 100.

papers.summary_cn: 论文针对 LLM 智能体按组织要求核查记录（例如漏洞报告是否具备进入调查的条件）时出现的两类失败：某项必需的检查已经失败，却仍然接受了该报告；以及没有尝试其他可能仍然成立的路径，就满足于一个更弱的结论。作者提出 PRIME（Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence）：它在核查开始前就固定“证据路线”，规定每一个结论可以如何被证成；再由一个独立程序记录每次检查的结果，并拒绝任何结果不足以支持的结论；当现有结果只能支持较弱结论时，它还会指出哪些检查可以支撑更强的结论，或者干脆自己执行这些检查。在 480 个公共记录任务上，直接向智能体展示要求的做法在 26.7% 的任务上给出了无依据的结论，而 PRIME 一次也没有；PRIME 的指引与追加检查把“有依据结论”的平均分从仅靠拒答时的 30.1 提升到满分 59.2。
innovations: 提出 PRIME 框架：在核查前预先承诺“证据路线”（evidence routes），显式规定每个结论允许由哪些检查与证据组合来证成，把结论与证据之间的映射从模型的隐式推理变成可审计的规则
设计与智能体分离的账本式判定程序：逐条记录每次检查结果，并按规则拒绝任何不被结果支持的结论，从机制上阻断“检查失败仍然接受”这一失败模式
加入主动补齐证据缺口的机制：当现有结果只能支撑较弱结论时，PRIME 会指向可证成更强结论的检查，或者自己执行这些检查，避免智能体降级收尾
在 480 个公共记录任务上给出量化结果：无依据结论率由 26.7% 降至 0，有依据结论平均分由拒答基线的 30.1 提升至 59.2/100
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于必须把结论追溯到可核查证据的合规审核类智能体，例如漏洞报告分诊、安全公告审核、内部记录对照组织规范的核查，尤其适合部署在“不得越权下结论、结论必须可复现审计”的 LLM 智能体系统中。

papers.title: Testing the Planning Claims of LLM-Based Agents against Formal Semantics
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly credited with the competences of practical reasoning: planning, monitoring, and correcting their own actions. Their success is attributed to the prompting strategies and agent architectures built around the model, such as chain-of-thought, search-based prompting, self-refinement, reflection, critics and tool-using loops. Yet these claims are usually supported by end-to-end success rates, which show only whether a task was completed, or by LLM judges, which are not verifiers. We test LLM planning against formal semantics. Tasks are posed in natural language, but each is grounded in a hidden PDDL model that decides whether every action is applicable, whether the goal is reached, and whether a plan exists at all. Across five domains (two of them new, all released with the paper), four models, six prompting strategies and three agent architectures, the best configuration solves 78% of the solvable tasks offline but only 40% online, where agents mostly act without inspecting the state. Unsolvable tasks are recognised in under 10% of episodes, and heavier prompting strategies use 5 to 22 times as many tokens as direct prompting with no clear gain. In our experiments, planning performance varied more across models than across prompting strategies or agent architectures. Claims that agents can plan require evidence from validated action traces.

papers.title_zh: 用形式语义检验基于 LLM 的智能体的规划主张
papers.summary_cn: 已有研究常借助 chain-of-thought、搜索式提示、self-refinement、reflection、critic 与工具循环等提示策略和智能体架构，来宣称 LLM 智能体具备规划、监控与自我纠错能力，但支撑证据通常只是端到端成功率（只能说明任务是否完成）或 LLM 评委（并不是验证器）。本文改用形式语义来检验这些规划主张：任务仍以自然语言给出，但每个任务都锚定在一个隐藏的 PDDL 模型上，由该模型判定动作是否可执行、目标是否达成、以及是否真的存在可行计划。实验覆盖 5 个领域（其中 2 个为本文新提出并随论文发布）、4 个模型、6 种提示策略与 3 种智能体架构，最佳配置在离线条件下解出 78% 的可解任务，在在线条件下仅有 40%，且智能体多数时候不检查当前状态就直接行动；对不可解任务的识别率不足 10%，更重的提示策略消耗的 token 是直接提示的 5 至 22 倍，却没有明确收益，性能差异主要来自模型而不是提示策略或架构。
innovations: 提出以隐藏 PDDL 模型作为形式化裁判的评测协议：自然语言任务背后由 PDDL 语义裁定动作可执行性、目标达成与可解性，取代端到端成功率与 LLM 评委作为验证手段
构建并发布 5 个领域的评测集，其中包含 2 个新领域，并系统组合 4 个模型、6 种提示策略与 3 种智能体架构进行受控对比
发现离线与在线之间存在显著落差：最佳配置离线解出 78% 的可解任务，在线仅 40%，原因是智能体大多不检查状态就行动；对不可解任务的识别率低于 10%
实证表明更重的提示与智能体策略（self-refinement、reflection、critic、搜索式提示等）token 消耗增加 5 至 22 倍却无明确收益，规划表现的方差更多来自模型而非策略或架构
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于规划型 LLM 智能体（任务自动化、工具调用 agent）的能力评估与选型：帮助团队在部署前判断“高成功率”究竟来自模型真实规划能力，还是来自评测口径的漏洞，并据此决定是否值得为更复杂的提示策略与智能体架构付出 token 成本。

papers.title: ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning
papers.abstract: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands to 1,500 retrieval documents. Dataset diagnostics confirm consistent identifiers and valid lighting fields while also revealing substantial dialogue repetition. A paired camera-ready evaluation compares single-combined and full multi-view retrieval under matched settings. The source code, dataset, and evaluation materials are publicly available.

papers.title_zh: ThetreStageAI：面向结构化孟加拉语戏剧制作规划的多视图检索增强生成
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对戏剧排演需要把台词、演员走位、舞台指示、灯光焦点、cue 时序与设备约束协调进同一份制作计划的问题，提出 ThetreStageAI——一个面向结构化孟加拉语戏剧制作规划的多视图检索增强生成框架。系统不采用单一混合语料检索，而是分别维护场景、演员走位（blocking）和灯光三个视图，用 BGE-M3 对孟加拉语文本编码并存入视图专属的 Qdrant 集合，检索结果与制作简报一并送入 Gemini，生成包含角色、场景、台词、舞台指示、走位、灯光与可选音效 cue 的 schema 约束 JSON，并在接受前做结构与语义校验，最多允许一次受限修复。作者还构建了人工引导、LLM 辅助的 500 条孟加拉语短剧记录合成数据集，扩展为 1500 篇检索文档，诊断显示标识符一致、灯光字段合法，但也暴露了明显的台词重复问题；成对评测在匹配设置下比较了单混合视图与完整多视图检索。
innovations: 提出按舞台要素拆分的多视图检索架构：场景、演员 blocking、灯光各自独立的 Qdrant 集合，避免单混合语料检索造成的跨要素语义混淆。
使用 BGE-M3 做孟加拉语嵌入，并将检索参考与制作简报共同作为条件，由 Gemini 输出带 schema 约束的 JSON 制作计划（角色/场景/台词/舞台指示/走位/灯光/音效 cue）。
设计生成后校验流程：结构检查加语义检查，仅在失败时允许一次受限修复，把 LLM 输出收敛到可执行的结构化制作计划。
构建并公开 500 条人工引导、LLM 辅助的孟加拉语戏剧合成数据集，扩展为 1500 篇检索文档，并通过诊断给出标识符一致、灯光字段有效、台词重复度偏高等具体数据质量结论。

papers.scenario_cn: 面向孟加拉语等低资源语种的小型剧团与舞台制作团队，把自然语言制作简报转成可直接执行的排演方案（走位、灯光 cue、台词与舞台指示），也适用于需要多要素协同约束的结构化创作规划系统。

papers.title: A Structure-Preserving Semi-Lagrangian based bi-fidelity method for the Vlasov--Poisson system with uncertainties
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification for the Vlasov--Poisson (VP) systems entails repeated dynamic simulations, incurring immense computational costs. We develop a structure-preserving Semi-Lagrangian (SL) b-fidelity approximation of macroscopic observables. The MUSCL is used as a low-fidelity solver for pressureless Euler--Poisson system, allowing for a more cost-effective exploration of the stochastic parameter space. A conservative SL scheme combined with high-order discontinuous Galerkin is used as a high-fidelity solver for collisionless VP system, whose mass conservation, positivity preservation, and low numerical dissipation provide a more reliable high-fidelity snapshots for bi-fidelity reconstruction. We further derive a conditional error bound that separates projection, discretization, and model errors. Numerical experiments for both deterministic and uncertain VP problems, including multispecies and higher-dimensional settings, demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves accurate and robust uncertainty propagation.

papers.title_zh: 面向含不确定性 Vlasov–Poisson 系统的保结构半拉格朗日双保真度方法
papers.summary_cn: 针对 Vlasov–Poisson（VP）系统不确定性量化需反复做动力学模拟、计算开销巨大的问题，论文提出一种保结构的半拉格朗日（SL）双保真度方法来逼近宏观可观测量。低保真端用 MUSCL 格式求解无压 Euler–Poisson 系统，以更低成本探索随机参数空间；高保真端用守恒型 SL 格式结合高阶间断伽辽金（DG）求解无碰撞 VP 系统，其质量守恒、正性保持与低数值耗散特性为双保真重构提供可靠快照。作者进一步推导了条件误差界，将投影误差、离散误差与模型误差分离。在确定性与不确定性 VP 问题（含多组分和高维设置）上的数值实验表明该框架能实现准确、稳健的不确定性传播。
innovations: 构建 MUSCL 求解无压 Euler–Poisson 作低保真、守恒 SL + 高阶 DG 求解无碰撞 VP 作高保真的双保真度配对，用低保真模型廉价采样随机参数空间后再重构宏观量
高保真求解器同时具备质量守恒、正性保持和低数值耗散，使双保真重构的快照在长时间演化下仍可信
推导出可分离投影误差、离散误差与模型误差的条件误差界，为双保真近似的可靠性给出理论刻画
在确定性、不确定性、多组分及高维 VP 算例上系统验证了不确定性传播的精度与稳健性
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于等离子体物理中无碰撞 Vlasov–Poisson 系统的不确定性量化与参数扫描，例如聚变等离子体与空间等离子体模拟中需要成千上万次重复仿真才能得到统计量的场合，可用少量高保真算例加大量低保真算例替代全高保真 Monte Carlo。

papers.title: ANCHOR: Audio-Visually Grounded Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Benchmark
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform well on audio-visual question answering, but correct answers do not necessarily imply that their stated reasoning is grounded in relevant perceptual evidence. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer accuracy, offering limited insight into whether model-generated rationales correctly identify visual regions, temporal intervals, and audio events supporting predictions. We introduce ANCHOR, a benchmark and evaluation framework for measuring grounded-rationale alignment in multimodal reasoning, comprising 2,319 videos and 8,272 question-answer pairs with structured reasoning traces, temporal evidence, spatial bounding boxes, and salient audio cues, including a human-refined test set of 224 videos and 975 question-answer pairs. We separately measure answer correctness, hallucination, logical divergence, and conciseness, with direct spatial and temporal grounding measurements on a focused subset. Across the full benchmark, twelve contemporary MLLMs show a substantial alignment gap: models with comparable answer performance can differ markedly in whether their explanations are supported by annotated evidence. On a matched subset of 100 videos and 446 question-answer pairs, rankings remain highly stable across human-refined, Gemini-generated, and GPT-generated references (mean Pearson r=0.99), providing evidence against model-reference circularity within this subset. Grounding-cue ablations of three MLLMs on the full human-refined test set reveal a consistent modality hierarchy: removing video reduces accuracy by 38.4-41.8 points, while removing bounding boxes (3.2-7.7 points) and audio (4.2-5.6 points) causes smaller, complementary, model-dependent drops. These findings show answer-only evaluation obscures important grounding failures and position ANCHOR as a testbed for evaluating accurate and evidence-aligned audio-visual reasoning.

papers.title_zh: ANCHOR：基于音视频感知证据的思维链推理基准
papers.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在音视频问答中“答对但推理未真正基于感知证据”的问题，作者提出 ANCHOR 基准与评测框架，用于衡量 grounded-rationale 对齐程度。数据集包含 2,319 段视频、8,272 条问答对，每条问答附带结构化推理链、时间证据区间、空间边界框与显著音频线索，并另设 224 段视频、975 条问答对的人工精修测试集。评测将答案正确性、幻觉、逻辑偏离与简洁性分开度量，并在聚焦子集上直接测量空间与时间 grounding。12 个当代 MLLM 在完整基准上表现出明显的对齐差距：答案性能相近的模型，其解释被标注证据支持的程度差异显著；在 100 段视频、446 条问答对的匹配子集上，人类精修、Gemini 生成、GPT 生成三种参考下模型排名高度稳定（平均 Pearson r=0.99），说明该子集不存在模型-参考循环性问题。三项 MLLM 在完整人工精修测试集上的 grounding 线索消融显示稳定的模态层级：去掉视频使准确率下降 38.4–41.8 个点，而去掉边界框（3.2–7.7 点）与音频（4.2–5.6 点）的下降更小，且呈互补的模型依赖模式。
innovations: 构建 ANCHOR 基准：2,319 段视频、8,272 条问答对，同时标注结构化思维链、时间证据区间、空间边界框与音频事件，是首个同时覆盖视觉区域、时间段与音频线索三类证据的 grounded 推理评测集。
提出四维解耦评测协议，将答案正确性、幻觉、逻辑偏离（logical divergence）与简洁性分别打分，并在聚焦子集上直接量化空间与时间 grounding 精度，而非仅看最终答案准确率。
通过 224 视频/975 问答对的人工精修测试集，以及在 100 视频/446 问答对子集上与 Gemini、GPT 生成参考的交叉验证（平均 Pearson r=0.99），给出反对“模型-参考循环性”质疑的实证证据。
在三项 MLLM 上的 grounding 线索消融揭示一致的模态层级：去掉视频损失 38.4–41.8 点，远大于去掉边界框（3.2–7.7 点）与音频（4.2–5.6 点）的损失，说明当前模型对细粒度证据的利用仍不充分。
在 12 个当代 MLLM 上测得“答案表现可比但解释证据支持度差异显著”的对齐差距，证明仅以答案准确率评测会掩盖关键的 grounding 失败。

papers.title: Beyond Expected Values: Risk-Sensitive Planning with Distributional Monte-Carlo Tree Search
papers.abstract: Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) typically stores only scalar mean estimates, which makes it poorly suited for tail-risk objectives such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). We introduce Categorical Thompson Sampling with Optimism (CATSO) and Particle Thompson Sampling with Optimism (PATSO), two distributional MCTS algorithms that maintain finite-support empirical backup laws at Q-edges. CATSO represents Q-edge laws with categorical atoms and Dirichlet Thompson sampling, while PATSO represents them with adaptive particles. Both algorithms select actions using the CVaR of a Thompson-sampled Q-edge law plus a polynomial optimism bonus, and propagate scalar continuation values through visit-weighted averages of child Q-edge CVaR scores. For the finite-depth nested CVaR planning target, we prove an $O(n^{-1/2})$ bound on the root value error after $n$ rollouts, which upper-bounds the risk-sensitive simple regret. CATSO adds a fixed-grid discretization bias, while capped PATSO adds a tunable Wasserstein compression bias. Experiments on stochastic planning benchmarks show that distributional Q-edges improve lower-tail return and reduce catastrophic outcomes when mean-optimal and risk-sensitive behavior differ.

papers.scenario_cn: 面向需要在不确定性下规避极端损失而非仅最大化平均收益的序贯决策系统，如金融交易与组合调仓、机器人/自动驾驶的安全规划、资源调度与库存控制，以及任何可仿真采样、可用 MCTS 做在线规划的强化学习服务。

papers.title: FuTransformer: FP8 prefill and INT4 decode for Llama-style inference on Hopper
papers.abstract: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. For gate/up projection with SwiGLU at the 8B shape, our BF16 path is 1.13x faster than CODA. Our FP8 path is 2.02-2.18x faster than the evaluated BF16 CODA path. Across 8B and 70B shapes at batches 1-32, INT4 decode is 1.3-2.4x faster than the faster of PyTorch's BF16 and INT4 blocks at each point: 2.1-3.3x faster than compiled, CUDA-graphed BF16 and 1.3-6.3x faster than the same block using PyTorch's INT4 projection kernel, which targets a single query row and loses to BF16 at batch 32. It is also 31-51% faster than our FP8 path. Complete Llama-3.1-8B decode takes 2.8 ms per step at batch one, versus 8.1 ms for the compiled transformers implementation. Decoding every WikiText-2 token through the INT4 weight path raises perplexity from 6.24 to 7.23 with round-to-nearest weights or 6.99 with GPTQ in the same format; the rotated INT4 cache adds 0.20. The kernels match a quantized reference computation within 0.001 perplexity.

papers.title: Not All Frames Are Equal:Difference-Aware Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit ASR
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods such as GPTQ and AWQ compress large language models effectively, but applying them to automatic speech recognition (ASR) at ultra-low bit-widths (2-3 bits) causes severe transcription degradation. Unlike discrete text tokens, speech activations are highly correlated in steady-state and zero-padded regions yet change rapidly at phonetic boundaries; when all frames contribute equally to the Hessian, static frames dominate calibration and obscure informative transitions. We propose DiffAQ, which computes frame-to-frame activation differences to measure the rate of acoustic change and assigns Hessian importance proportionally, concentrating quantization precision on phonetically critical frames. As a training-free modification to GPTQ, DiffAQ consistently reduces WER across various Whisper sizes and standard benchmarks, with the largest gains at 2-bit precision where baseline methods frequently produce degenerate outputs.

papers.title: OwlSight: A Panoramic Monitor for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.

papers.title: Dynamic Load Balancing under Restricting Updates
papers.abstract: We study the problem of load balancing in the dynamic setting. The input is a bipartite graph $G = (J \cup M, E)$ of jobs $J$ and machines $M$. Every job has a positive weight $w(j)$. The goal is to assign every job in $J$ to an adjacent machine in $M$ so as to minimize the maximum machine load, where the load of a machine is the sum of the weights of the jobs assigned to it. Although load balancing has been studied extensively in many models of computation, the only previous result in the dynamic model addresses the \emph{incremental} setting, where updates take the form of edge insertions and job deletions [BKS23b]. The authors show a $(1+\epsilon)$-approximation for incremental \emph{fractional} load balancing with $\text{poly}(\log(n),1/\epsilon)$ update time; they point out that their techniques do not extend to the decremental setting. Main Result: We obtain an algorithm which maintains a $(1+\epsilon)$-approximate solution to the fractional load balancing problem under edge deletions and job insertions in $\tilde{O}(\log (n), 1/\epsilon)$ update time. Our techniques are very different from those of the incremental algorithm of [BKS23b]. Instead, our algorithm is inspired by a load-balancing algorithm from the {\sc congest} model of computation [ALPZ21]. We develop a novel analytic framework for this algorithm, which allows us to show that it performs well in the dynamic setting. Rounding Scheme: We also present a black-box rounding scheme for dynamic load balancing. Plugging in our fractional algorithm, we obtain a decremental algorithm for $(2+\epsilon)$-approximate \emph{integral} load balancing with $\text{poly}(\log(n),1/\epsilon)$ update time. We also obtain the same bounds for incremental load balancing by plugging in the fractional algorithm of [BKS23b].

papers.summary_cn: 论文研究动态模型下的负载均衡问题：输入为作业集合 J 与机器集合 M 构成的二部图，每个作业带正权重，目标是把作业分配到相邻机器上以最小化最大机器负载。此前唯一的动态模型结果 [BKS23b] 只覆盖增量场景（边插入与作业删除），给出增量分数负载均衡的 (1+ε) 近似与 poly(log n, 1/ε) 更新时间，并明确指出其技术无法推广到递减（decremental）场景。本文转而借鉴 CONGEST 模型中的负载均衡算法 [ALPZ21]，为其开发了新的分析框架，从而在边删除与作业插入下以 Õ(log n, 1/ε) 更新时间维持 (1+ε) 近似分数解。作者进一步给出通用的黑盒取整方案，插入本文分数算法得到 (2+ε) 近似的递减式整数负载均衡，插入 [BKS23b] 的分数算法则得到增量场景下相同的整数界。

papers.title: FloodVLM-Pix: Language-Guided Pixel-Level Flood Understanding
papers.abstract: As climate change intensifies, floods are becoming more frequent and destructive, making accurate flood understanding an urgent priority. However, existing vision-language models perform poorly on flood-related tasks, suffering from attentional bias and inaccurate descriptions of flood magnitude. To bridge this gap, we construct the first large-scale remote sensing flood multi-modal benchmark that supports language-level flood understanding and pixel-level flood segmentation. The benchmark contains 131,200 flood image patches and corresponding 443,100 textual descriptions for flood severity and evolution. Based on this benchmark, we propose FloodVLM-Pix, a language-guided pixel-level flood understanding model that includes a flood prior module and a multi-temporal flood pixel decoder to achieve accurate flood understanding. The flood prior module automatically distills sub-region flood spatial priors and inputs priors into FloodVLM-Pix, solving the attentional bias problem in flood language understanding. The flood pixel decoder introduces a novel general-specific feature fusion mechanism to address performance degradation caused by interference (e.g., clouds or mountain shadows) during flood segmentation. Experiments on FloodVL-Pix demonstrate that FloodVLM-Pix improves both flood description quality and pixel-level flood segmentation performance compared with state-of-the-art VLMs and flood segmentation models. Our code and data will be released at this https URL .

papers.title: I2V-DETACH: Source Grounding Detachment for Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract: Recent diffusion models have advanced image-conditioned video generation, but their accessibility raises risks of unauthorized manipulation. Image immunization has emerged as a promising defense for Image-to-Video (I2V) protection, yet existing methods often rely on degrading visual quality or temporal coherence. In this work, we revisit I2V immunization as reducing source-content preservation, shifting the focus from output degradation to weakening source-conditioned content propagation. To this end, we propose I2V-DETACH, an image immunization method that prevents unauthorized I2V generation through source grounding detachment. I2V models preserve source content by propagating source-image cues into video latents during denoising. Accordingly, I2V-DETACH disrupts this process in two complementary ways: it suppresses source-video grounding to reduce source cue propagation, and strengthens intra-video interactions to shift denoising toward video-side dynamics with reduced reliance on the source image. To obtain informative optimization signals, we initialize auxiliary video latents with source-oriented states that remain within the source-conditioned generation regime while deviating from source-preserving trajectories. Extensive experiments across diverse diffusion architectures show that I2V-DETACH substantially reduces source-content preservation, improves over prior immunization methods, and exhibits strong black-box transferability.

papers.title: Interpreting SSL Representations for Spoof Detection: a WavLM Study
papers.abstract: Self-supervised speech models such as WavLM achieve strong spoofing detection performance, yet which layers encode the most spoof-relevant information and what acoustic properties they capture remain opaque. We present a layer-wise interpretability study of WavLM using the ASVspoof 5 database, combining three complementary analyses: (i) per-layer linear probing with attack-level evaluation across speech synthesis, voice conversion, and adversarial attacks; (ii) a canonical correlation analysis (CCA) linking layer representations to spoofing-relevant acoustic features; (iii) an exhaustive grid search over layer subsets showing that use of five layers outperforms full thirteen-layer pooling. CCA analysis reveals that, while most acoustic features peak in alignment with mid-layers and then decay, voice quality measures jitter, shimmer, and the harmonics-to-noise ratio show the opposite trend, with correlation increasing toward later layers. Embedding visualisations reveal that deeper layers capture a continuous acoustic similarity among attacks rather than discrete categories, suggesting these layers encode fundamental synthesis artifacts rather than attack-specific signatures.

papers.title_zh: 面向欺骗检测的自监督学习表征可解释性：一项 WavLM 研究
papers.summary_cn: 本文针对 WavLM 等自监督语音模型在欺骗检测上性能强、但“哪一层编码了欺骗相关信息、对应哪些声学属性”仍不透明的问题，在 ASVspoof 5 数据库上开展逐层可解释性研究。方法上组合三条分析路径：对每一层做线性探针并按语音合成、声音转换、对抗攻击分别做攻击级评估；用典型相关分析（CCA）把层表征与欺骗相关声学特征对齐；再对层子集做穷举网格搜索。结果发现仅用 5 层做池化即可超过全部 13 层的池化效果；CCA 显示多数声学特征在中层相关性最高随后衰减，而 jitter、shimmer、谐噪比（HNR）等嗓音质量指标相反，随层加深持续上升。嵌入可视化进一步表明，深层刻画的是各攻击之间连续的声学相似性而非离散攻击类别，提示其编码的是基础合成伪影而非攻击特有签名。

对层子集做穷举网格搜索，实证 5 层子集池化优于完整 13 层池化，说明部分深层对欺骗检测存在信息稀释

papers.title: MLLM Frame Subset Ensembling for Audio-Visual Video QA and MLLM-based Reranking for Ad-hoc Video Search in TRECVID 2025
papers.abstract: This paper presents the overview of the runs related to the Ad-hoc Video Search (AVS) and Video Question Answering (VQA) tracks of TRECVID 2025 on behalf of the CERTH-ITI team. For the AVS track, we introduce a two-stage framework built on foundation models. In the first stage, multiple vision-language models (VLMs) encode both the input query, augmented through LLM-generated rephrasings, and the candidate video shots, producing weighted similarity scores for initial retrieval. In the second stage, we utilize a Multimodal-LLM(MLLM)-based reranking module that evaluates the semantic alignment between each shot among the top-N highest-ranked ones and the original query, generating updated relevance scores for reordering these shots. This MLLM-driven reranking significantly improves contextual matching and produces more accurate final rankings without requiring any model training. Regarding the VQA track, we fine-tune an audio-visual MLLM model on the provided TRECVID training dataset and we implement an inference-time scaling technique to enhance the multimodal understanding capabilities of the MLLM. For the open-ended Answer Generation (AG) task, we aggregate multiple model responses per question via a majority vote. The responses are generated with greedy sampling from different random frame subsets of the video and they are ranked based on the number of votes. For the Multiple-Choice (MC) task, instead of voting, we use mean pooling on the logits assigned by the fine-tuned model to each candidate response. Through the combination of fine-tuning and frame subset ensembling we achieve the highest score across 3 metrics in the VQA AG task and the second highest in the VQA MC task.

papers.title: Water-Energy-Data nexus reveals sustainability gaps and priorities for AI infrastructure
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) depends on interconnected water, energy, and data systems spanning infrastructure life cycles and diverse geographies, with the potential to intensify water and energy insecurity, exacerbate social inequities and lead to cascading sustainability issues globally. Yet assessments commonly examine them separately, limiting our understanding of where resource pressures arise, how they are transferred across space, and who bears their consequences. To address these challenges, we established a water-energy-data (WED) nexus framework that captures the spatial and life-cycle dependencies of AI infrastructure, and use large language models to synthesize 12,825 water- or energy-related studies across four resource-intensive AI infrastructure activities: mineral extraction, semiconductor manufacturing, data center operation and electronic-waste processing. The evidence map identifies a mismatch between the interconnected activities supporting AI infrastructure and boundaries used to assess them. Researchers assess operational energy more than water use and other indirect demands, while interactions across locations and life-cycle activities remain understudied. These gaps obscure how resource demands shift among infrastructure nodes and regions, and how data-enabled benefits compare with their underlying costs. The WED nexus provides a foundation for integrated assessment of spatially metacoupled systems, while the evidence map can inform priorities for managing the sustainability implications of the AI boom.

papers.title_zh: 水-能-数据关联视角揭示 AI 基础设施的可持续性缺口与优先事项

papers.title: A Stronger Teacher Within: Strengthening MoE Models via On-Policy Bidirectional Distillation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, but its outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision. On-Policy Distillation offers dense token-level feedback, yet requires a stronger compatible teacher, while on-policy self-distillation relies on hand-designed privileged information. We observe that the MoE architecture itself offers a way to resolve this dilemma, as increasing the activation budget per token exposes latent expert capacity and yields a potentially stronger teacher within the model. However, naive expansion degrades performance because newly co-activated experts are not optimized to work together. We therefore propose MoEvolve, a bidirectional distillation framework following a recovery-then-improvement strategy: we first restore the activation-expanded high-$k$ model and further strengthen it by exploiting its additional active capacity, then reverse the direction of distillation to transfer the enhanced capabilities back into the original low-$k$ configuration, retaining its inference-time activation budget. Across diverse MoE models and benchmarks, MoEvolve improves the initial models by up to $22.2$ domain-average points and outperforms same-budget RLVR baselines by up to $6.5$ points. Notably, the final low-$k$ models often surpass their activation-expanded teachers.

papers.title: AlphaLedger: Portfolio-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Regime-Aware Alpha Mining
papers.abstract: Hosted LLMs enable automated alpha mining but incur recurring API costs and expose research context to external providers. Training a local generator requires supervision aligned with portfolio utility: a predictive factor may add little after redundancy and trading costs. This incremental value is assessed only after the factor program is complete, whereas generation proceeds sequentially. Deployment must also adapt to evolving stock-specific evidence and changes in factor effectiveness across market regimes. We propose AlphaLedger to address these challenges. Economic-context on-policy distillation (EC-OPD) conditions a frozen teacher on completed factors and their cost-adjusted marginal portfolio contributions, then distills its legal-action distributions along the student's own trajectories. The deployed generator requires neither teacher calls nor outcome inputs. EviPool constructs a dynamic stock universe from lagged multi-source evidence, while a regime-residual gate (RRG) reweights factors using matured, state-matched returns with shrinkage and bounded deviations from equal weighting. On Chinese A-shares, AlphaLedger achieves a 55.4\% annualized net return, a Sharpe ratio of 2.06, and a maximum drawdown of 10.8\%. In a common CSI500 universe, its annualized net return exceeds the strongest baseline by 43.6\% (31.6\% vs.\ 22.0\%), with a 13.5\% higher Sharpe ratio.

papers.title: Beyond Large Language Models: A Mental World Model Framework for Mental Modeling, Simulation, Evolution, and Interpretability
papers.abstract: Understanding and simulating how subjective cognition and mental states emerge, evolve, and shape behavior is essential for advancing artificial intelligence toward deeper social cognition and general intelligence. Existing large language models (LLMs) and Theory of Mind (ToM) methods primarily infer mental states from linguistic information, lacking unified mechanisms for subjective world construction, cognitive-psychological interactions, dynamic evolution, and historical dependencies. This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and its implementation, the Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly constructs subjective worlds, models interactions between cognition and mental states, and simulates continuous mental evolution shaped by historical experiences. On DynToM and RecToM, MMEA achieves 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy, respectively, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods. Additional experiments demonstrate improvements of 28.7, 39.3, and 16.6 percentage points in mental state and behavior prediction, long-sequence prediction, and implicit mental state inference, respectively. The results demonstrate that MMEA provides an interpretable framework for continuous mental modeling, enabling AI to move beyond surface-level semantic representations to infer individuals' underlying mental states from linguistic information and dynamically simulate their internal cognitive processes and evolution over time. MWM also provides a promising foundation for causal reasoning, personalized AI, sustained human-AI interaction, and future advances toward artificial general intelligence (AGI).

papers.title: COMET: Decoupled Distillation, Routing, and Capacity Control for Task-Agnostic Continual Vision--Language Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. We design COMET to keep capacity and inference separate: a contextual bandit keeps or merges full per-task experts using post-training signals, while a reconstruction router selects sparse experts at test time without teacher semantics. On the X-TAIL benchmark, we show that each proposed component improves continual learning performance. COMET shows that continual vision-language adaptation can preserve multimodal geometry, coordinate accumulated experts, and allocate capacity jointly when feature reference, expert shaping, routing, and capacity control are separated by construction.

papers.summary_cn: CLIP 类视觉-语言模型保留了零样本识别能力，但其开放世界部署常需要任务无关的持续学习：任务顺序到达、过去数据不可用、任务身份未知且主干无法重训。论文指出该设定下 VLM 除稳定性-可塑性权衡外还承受三重耦合压力：模态一致性漂移、表示空间干扰与单任务容量不足，并提出 COMET（协作式专家混合迁移）分别应对。冻结教师仅在共享图文池上提供特征参考，Tri-Affinity Distillation 同时保持图像-图像、文本-文本与图文三种亲和几何；Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation 让新专家与兼容的历史专家对齐，使路由出错时性能优雅退化；容量与推理被刻意分离——上下文 bandit 依据训练后信号保留或合并整任务专家，重建路由器在测试时稀疏选择专家且不依赖教师语义。在 X-TAIL 基准上验证各组件均提升持续学习表现。

papers.title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
papers.abstract: Text-based world models have recently shown potential to simulate complex RL environment state transitions for a diverse set of use cases. However, no standardized benchmark exists to compare, study and improve these models. Through this paper, we attempt to solve this problem by building GlobeBench, a novel benchmark with 1,632 tasks across five separate domains and nineteen simulation skills. The tasks check whether models can predict the environment's response to a specific action given the full agent trajectory by understanding earlier state changes, following environment rules, and predicting the effects of actions on both related and unrelated objects. We compare the predicted environment response with an execution-derived reference, using a hybrid architecture with both deterministic gates and a semantic judge. Among 20 general-purpose LLMs and specialized text world models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate at 49.57%. We find that model accuracy decreases as actions affect a larger portion of the environment. Specifically, when the agent's changes must propagate to dependent objects, task success drops to an average of 5.1% across all 20 models. Although model strengths differ across tasks, 631 tasks remain unsolved by any model, suggesting a significant gap in general LLM capabilities as a world model.

papers.title: DIFFLET: A Fast Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformer Models on AWS Trainium
papers.abstract: On AWS Trainium2, every component of a diffusion model runs as a program compiled ahead of time for fixed shapes, while pipelines differ across models, prompt lengths across requests, and caching decisions across denoising steps. We present Difflet, a serving engine in which five model pipelines share one compilation backend, joint attention is split across cores by attention head, and a host controller decides at each denoising step whether to run the denoiser or reuse its earlier output. A small probe program computes the caching signal on the device and returns one number per step, and a resident model process keeps every program loaded across requests. Across five image and video model families, fused attention accelerates denoiser steps by 1.2-4.3x over the same framework using PyTorch/XLA attention, and at 32.8k visual tokens it is the only attention that compiles. On four of the five models, resident serving is 1.5-3.4x faster than standalone runs that reload weights from a warm file cache for each generation.

papers.title: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
papers.abstract: Creative intent in video editing can be expressed through text instructions (e.g., "remove the people"), image references (e.g., subject appearance), video references (e.g., camera movement), or a combination of the above. We introduce OmniXRef, a unified framework for multimodal multi-reference video editing that allows users to combine variable numbers of text, image, and video references to control diverse attributes of a source video. We first devise a unified input design with a reference-bank interface and introduce $R^2$-RoPE to support generalization to more references. Then our model, OmniXRef-Model, uses a single-stream diffusion transformer to jointly process the source video and multimodal context from an MLLM in an interleaved sequence. To address the scarcity of training data for video-reference editing, we construct OmniXRef-Data using synthesis pipelines for different editing tasks and combinations of references. We use curriculum learning to progressively increase task complexity and resolution. To support systematic evaluation of video as a control modality, we introduce OmniXRef-Bench, a benchmark for video-reference attribute transfer across Camera, Motion, Content, Style, and Visual Effects (VFX). Comprehensive evaluations show that our OmniXRef-Model outperforms task-specific baselines and commercial models.

papers.title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
papers.abstract: We study the conditional distribution of limit-order volume submitted over the next five minutes, given the current order book and recent order flow. The task requires capturing price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty jointly. Coordinate-wise diffusion losses do not explicitly account for price displacement, while normalizing fields to unit mass removes information about total volume. Agreement on selected summary statistics also does not establish fidelity to the joint field distribution. We introduce OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer for unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport (UOT) auxiliary loss. We also develop a full-field evaluation framework that combines a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics. In the primary comparison on 1950 validation conditions across 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduces full-field transport cost by 45.8% and the transport energy score by 26.1% relative to training with mean squared error alone. Both measures improve for every stock. These findings support incorporating price geometry and volume into generative modeling, with field accuracy and predictive uncertainty evaluated together.

papers.title: ProactGen: Learning Proactive Clarification for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video generation let users create high-quality videos from natural language descriptions, yet obtaining results that match user intent remains time-consuming: individual generations are computationally expensive, and underspecified prompts force repeated cycles of generation, inspection, and revision. Existing video prompt optimization methods improve generation through automatic rewriting, but cannot supply the ideas and preferences that were not in the initial description. We propose ProactGen, a video generation framework that learns proactive clarification, eliciting user intent through questions grounded in generated video drafts. Specifically, we train a vision-language model as a questioning policy with reinforcement learning: observing the initial prompt and a video draft, it learns to ask the questions most valuable to downstream generation, rewarded by the alignment between the final generated video and a target reference. We further find that effective questioning does not require drafts of final-output quality, and exploit this property by generating drafts with fewer denoising steps, keeping the added cost of clarification low. Experiments show that ProactGen improves target alignment over direct generation by at least 1.8x the gain of the strongest baselines. Moreover, a single round of ProactGen already exceeds the alignment that the strongest baseline reaches after four refinement rounds, in 29% of its time.

papers.title: BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL
papers.abstract: Humanoid control requires coordinating whole-body posture with position and heading in the world frame. Mainstream controllers imitate trajectories in the root frame, but struggle to regain the target world pose after displacement. We introduce BeJEPA, a goal-conditioned Behavior World Model learned through unsupervised reinforcement learning from human motion priors and robot interaction. BeJEPA learns a shared representation of body configuration and world placement through a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). A Dynamic Predictor predicts the next state embedding under an action, while a Successor Predictor summarizes a goal-conditioned policy's expected discounted future state embeddings in a single vector. During joint training, Dynamic grounds the initial representation in observed physical transitions, while Successor increasingly organizes it around long-term behavior. Their composition guides policy improvement through one physical prediction and one behavioral summary, without long imagined rollouts. In 20-second motion-tracking experiments, BeJEPA with online action refinement using Dynamic outperforms all evaluated baselines in global body-position error, reducing it on AMASS by 61.7% relative to BFM-Zero with world-pose inputs and 58.7% relative to SONIC. Physical deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates joint attainment of posture, world position, and heading goals, recovery from the ground, and closed-loop return after disturbances and goal changes. papers.title: ENFR: Evidence Networks with Flow-Matched References for Amortized Simulation-Based Model Inference
papers.abstract: The evidence, $\mathcal{Z} = p(x | \mathcal{M})$, of a data-generating model $\mathcal{M}$ is a powerful tool in Bayesian frameworks: it enables model inference, model misspecification tests, and goodness-of-fit assessment as an alternative to standard discrepancy statistics, e.g. $\chi^2$. While versatile, the evidence is notoriously difficult to compute, even when the likelihood is available. In both likelihood-based and simulation-based inference, estimating $\mathcal{Z}$ provides an immediate solution to high-dimensional goodness-of-fit or model misspecification tests: using $\mathcal{Z}(x)$ as the test statistic induces a minimum-volume level-$\alpha$ test. Such tests are essential to assess model fidelity, which is necessary to trust simulation-based parameter inference. Existing learned approaches largely target Bayes factors, which only measure evidence ratios. Instead, we provide accurate, fast, and amortized estimates of the absolute evidence. We present ENFR: Evidence Networks with Flow-matched References. Building on the Evidence Network framework of Jeffrey & Wandelt (2024), the proposed method first learns Bayes factors with respect to a flow-matched reference, from which the absolute evidence is recovered. We show improvement in estimation of $\mathcal{Z}$ over the flow-based baseline in all applications considered and the best performance of all density estimation methods considered in our benchmarks. We furthermore introduce and provide the proof for an architecture that jointly learns the individual evidences of a set of models $\{\mathcal{M}_i\}$. We demonstrate the performance and scaling behavior of these approaches on data from a variety of scientific applications.

提出并证明可联合学习一组模型 {M_i} 各自证据的网络架构，避免对每个模型单独训练证据估计器。
在多个科学应用的基准上，ENFR 相对 flow-based 基线全面改进，并在所有比较的密度估计方法中取得最佳证据估计精度，同时给出摊销式快速估计的规模扩展表现。
papers.scenario_cn: 用于基于模拟的推断（SBI）以及似然可得场景下的模型保真度评估：做高维 goodness-of-fit、模型误设检测与模型选择，先确认仿真模型可信，再用于参数推断。

papers.title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
papers.abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out the requested instruction. Relative to the baseline, it more than triples the MIST reveal score. On the benchmarks, WRBench's score T rises by 26.1% and MBench-T's score U by 52.7%. The method meets the problem from the execution side: it shows what the frozen model can do once the move is stated, and it sets a stricter baseline.

papers.title_zh: 执行先于记忆：诊断视频世界模型中的记忆失效
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出，当前视频世界模型的记忆评测把“场景是否被设定”“指定变化是否被执行”“末帧是否呈现结果”混为单一分数，低分容易被误读为遗忘；而未被执行的改变根本不会产生隐状态转移，因此这种评测实际上并未测到记忆。作者提出 MIST 评测，把变化本身与它应留下的记忆分离：模型先在变化隐藏的情况下建立场景，之后才被要求展示该变化，并控制此前发生的信息泄漏。据此定位出瓶颈在“执行”而非“记忆”，进而提出 M3-Agent（Make the Missing Move），递归修订输入指令的细节以促使模型完成所要求的动作。相对基线，它使 MIST reveal 分数提升三倍以上，WRBench 的 T 分数提升 26.1%，MBench-T 的 U 分数提升 52.7%。

诊断发现瓶颈在执行而非记忆：模型能建立场景却未执行指令中的变化，同一缺口在通用记忆评测中同样出现。
M3-Agent（Make the Missing Move）通过递归修订输入指令细节，让冻结的视频世界模型把此前缺失的动作真正执行出来。
实验给出量化收益：MIST reveal 分数提升三倍以上，WRBench T 提升 26.1%、MBench-T U 提升 52.7%，并由此建立了更严格的基线。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于视频与交互式世界模型的评测及推理期增强：当生成模型看似“记不住”前序内容时，先判别是否属于指令未被执行，再在不重训模型的前提下改善长时程场景一致性与可控生成。

papers.title: ASR-Style Transcript Normalization Removes Useful Pragmatic Signal for Dialogue Act Classification
papers.abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) pipelines often normalize transcripts by removing filled pauses and punctuation and expanding colloquial forms, potentially discarding cues useful for dialogue act classification. We evaluate nine transcript conditions across six classifiers (TF-IDF logistic regression, RoBERTa, BERT, ALBERT, GPT-2, and BiLSTM) and three conversational corpora (Switchboard, ICSI MRDA, and SLUE-HVB), supplemented by multi-seed experiments, normalization controls, and real-ASR evaluations. Across five random seeds, heavy normalization reduces Macro-F1 in all 15 neural model-corpus combinations under the original preprocessing protocols. Removal using the original filler and backchannel lexicon consistently degrades performance on MRDA and SLUE-HVB but produces mixed effects on Switchboard. Punctuation-aware TF-IDF experiments show that punctuation removal reduces Macro-F1 by 0.036 on Switchboard and 0.078 on MRDA, demonstrating that the original linear baseline's apparent insensitivity resulted from tokenization. Restricting filler removal to um, uh, and erm preserves degradation on MRDA but largely eliminates the SLUE-HVB effect, where the original lexicon removes class-defining backchannel expressions. These findings demonstrate that normalization effects depend on preprocessing definitions, feature extraction, and conversational context, supporting task-dependent rather than indiscriminate transcript normalization.

papers.title_zh: ASR 风格的转写文本规范化会移除对对话行为分类有用的语用信号
papers.summary_cn: 该论文研究语音识别流水线中常见的转写文本规范化（删除填充停顿、标点并展开口语形式）是否会连带抹掉对话行为分类所需的语用线索。作者构造了 9 种转写条件，在 Switchboard、ICSI MRDA、SLUE-HVB 三个对话语料上对比 TF-IDF 逻辑回归、RoBERTa、BERT、ALBERT、GPT-2 与 BiLSTM 六类分类器的 Macro-F1，并补充多种子实验、规范化对照实验与真实 ASR 输出评测。结果显示，在 5 个随机种子下，重度规范化使全部 15 个神经模型-语料组合的 Macro-F1 一致下降；标点感知的 TF-IDF 实验表明删除标点在 Switchboard 上使 Macro-F1 降低 0.036、在 MRDA 上降低 0.078，说明原线性基线的"不敏感"其实是分词方式造成的假象。把填充词删除限定为 um、uh、erm 后，MRDA 上的性能退化仍然存在，而 SLUE-HVB 上的效应基本消失，因为原词表删掉的正是承担类别区分作用的回应词（backchannel）。
innovations: 提出并系统比较 9 种转写规范化条件的实验框架，覆盖 6 类分类器（TF-IDF LR、RoBERTa、BERT、ALBERT、GPT-2、BiLSTM）× 3 个对话语料（Switchboard、ICSI MRDA、SLUE-HVB）× 5 个随机种子，给出 15 个神经模型-语料组合的一致性证据
用标点感知的 TF-IDF 对照实验定位机制：原线性基线的"不敏感"源于分词把标点直接丢弃，显式保留标点后删除标点分别使 Switchboard / MRDA 的 Macro-F1 下降 0.036 / 0.078
设计受限填充词删除消融（仅 um、uh、erm），证明 MRDA 上的退化来自填充停顿本身，而 SLUE-HVB 上的退化主要来自原词表误删的 backchannel 表达，即效应依赖规范化词表的定义
引入真实 ASR 输出评测与规范化对照，指出规范化收益/损失取决于预处理定义、特征提取方式与会话语境三者交互，而非单一方向的"清洗更干净就更好"
给出可操作结论：应做任务相关的选择性规范化，而非不加区分地统一清洗转写文本
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于语音识别后处理与对话理解系统的流水线设计，例如客服通话分析、会议记录理解、口语对话行为/意图识别；提示在需要识别回应词、犹豫标记等语用线索的任务中，不应套用为可读性优化的通用清洗规则。

papers.title: An Interactive GraphRAG Workspace for Reifying, Auditing, and Steering Conversational AI Memories
papers.abstract: Conversational Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely employed in software engineering for code generation, debugging, and architectural design. However, as developers engage in multi-session development tasks, technical knowledge becomes siloed in isolated, linear chat histories. Reusing context across sessions leads to three critical challenges: (1) flat-vector retrieval fails to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies between distant architectural decisions; (2) temporal drift in software packages and APIs results in silent context poisoning when reusing aged dialogue logs; and (3) raw conversation concatenation induces prompt bloat and attention degradation. We present CognitiveCanvas, an interactive tool that transforms conversational AI memories from ephemeral text logs into persistent, manipulable, and audited knowledge objects. \textsc{CognitiveCanvas} integrates: (1) a Hierarchical Semantic Fact-Graph (HSFG) that distills dialogues into Goal, Fact, and Code artifacts, achieving a 92.2\% token reduction while enabling multi-hop GraphRAG traversal; (2) a Continuous Temporal Drift Auditor coupling 60+ regex heuristics with live calendar-anchored LLM verification for 1-click self-correction; and (3) a Spatial-Symbolic Prompt Compiler (SSPC) that translates 2D direct manipulation gestures (Voronoi clustering, node resizing, synthesis edges) directly into structured attention directives

innovations: 提出分层语义事实图 HSFG，把对话抽取为 Goal / Fact / Code 三级工件，在保持多跳 GraphRAG 可遍历性的同时实现 92.2% 的 token 压缩

提出空间-符号提示编译器 SSPC，把 Voronoi 聚类、节点缩放、合成边等二维直接操作手势直接编译为结构化注意力指令，让用户通过图形操作而非重写提示来"操控"模型注意力

papers.title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
papers.abstract: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. A later run changes six predictions despite identical core worker code. A bounded audit of 1,090 benchmark-related corpus records finds exact question or context overlap for 38 processed evaluation inputs, precluding an unqualified claim of corpus-independent generalization. The contribution is a concrete retrieval-and-computation judging architecture with an auditable operational characterization, not a controlled estimate of component gains. We distinguish the reported leaderboard result from independently recomputed diagnostics and identify the evidence needed for stronger effectiveness and reproducibility claims.

papers.title_zh: 结合检索与程序执行的孟加拉语幻觉检测：一项系统研究
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究的是孟加拉语场景下、且往往不提供参考段落时，如何区分“缺乏依据的事实陈述”与“推理错误”这两类幻觉。作者构建了一个仅用于推理的系统：先做以模型回答为条件的查询重写与混合检索，用六条检索路径并行搜索问答与段落语料，再由路由模块把样本分派给 27B 文本裁判，或分派给能比较检索答案、直接推理、并生成执行 Python 的 14B 智能体。在 Olikbochon 竞赛数据上，Version 2 对应 Kaggle 展示的 private macro-F1 0.956，其保存的运行记录显示 2,516 条样本在两块 T4 GPU 上耗时 220.99 分钟；253 条被路由到数学分支的样本中有 88 条通过候选匹配终止，执行轨迹在 35 条样本中共记录 49 次带 stderr 的运行事件。作者还审计了 1,090 条与基准相关的语料记录，发现 38 条被处理的评测输入与语料存在问题或上下文的精确重叠；并且在核心 worker 代码相同的情况下重跑仍有 6 条预测发生变化，因此论文把排行榜成绩与独立复算的诊断分开陈述，不对“语料独立泛化”下无条件结论。
innovations: 提出“检索+计算”的裁判架构：以回答为条件的查询重写、六条并行检索路径的混合检索，以及 27B 文本裁判与可执行 Python 的 14B 智能体双分支路由。
以纯推理方式在 Olikbochon 孟加拉语基准上取得 Kaggle private macro-F1 0.956（Version 2），并完整记录 2,516 条样本、双 T4 上 220.99 分钟的运行成本。
给出可审计的运行刻画：253 条数学分支样本中 88 条经候选匹配终止，35 条样本共出现 49 次带 stderr 的执行事件，暴露程序执行路径的失败面。
通过重复运行（相同核心 worker 代码下 6 条预测漂移）与 1,090 条语料记录审计（38 条评测输入存在问题或上下文精确重叠）揭示可复现性与语料泄漏风险。

papers.title: Characterising and Analysing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Techniques
papers.abstract: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) across many application domains has increased the need for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to reduce hallucinations and improve LLM performance. Thus far, several RAG techniques with impressive features and capabilities have been proposed in the literature, making it a herculean task to select the most appropriate RAG techniques for specific problem scenarios. Thus, we propose a conceptual framework comprising main dimensions and sub-dimensions for characterising (defining "what it is") and analysing (defining "how well it does") existing RAG techniques. The conceptual framework was developed through a qualitative analysis of the attributes of RAG techniques reported in the literature. It can serve as a pre-empirical filtering mechanism for researchers and practitioners in selecting the highest-fit RAG candidates that meet specific user and task requirements before empirical benchmarking of RAG techniques, which can be computationally and financially expensive.

papers.title: Code Skill Server: A Large-Scale Search Engine for Code Generation Skills
papers.abstract: Agent skills have proven to be an effective technique for improving agent ability on specific tasks, including software engineering, natural science, and mathematics. During such a process, using agent skills often involves manually discovering and organizing skills from heterogeneous sources, while existing skill retrieval methods mainly focus on selecting relevant skills from established skill libraries. However, with the rapidly increasing number and variety of reusable agent skills, manually searching for relevant skills across heterogeneous sources is becoming impractical at scale. In this paper, we introduce the Code Skill Server (CSS), a large-scale search engine for finding the most useful code generation skills for a target task. CSS consists of a skill server that incrementally collects and indexes publicly available code generation skills from multiple sources, with 993 skills included in the corpus used in this work. Extensive experiments across different retrieval methods and code generation benchmarks show that the best CSS configuration improves Pass@1 by up to 13.91% and consistently improves all evaluated models by at least 4.21% in the cross-model evaluation. These results demonstrate that CSS can effectively search for and serve relevant skills, improving code generation quality and enhancing models' code generation capabilities. papers.title: Control design for a class of nonlinear convection-reaction systems with storage effects and relative degree one
papers.abstract: This article addresses the control design for systems of several convection-reaction equations distributively coupled to a reaction equation. In typical applications, input and output are associated exclusively with the convection-reaction subsystems. Along the common characteristics of the transport processes, the system can be reduced to a single delayed evolutionary ODE. Based on the latter representation, an inversion-based feedforward control is proposed, whose properties depend on the coupling structure of the original system. While the relative degree of the output is zero in many cases, a relative degree of one is of particular interest for practical applications. To compensate for uncertainties and disturbances, the feedforward control is extended by a tracking controller with a predictor based on the transformed system to account for the resulting delays.

papers.title_zh: 一类具有储能效应、相对阶为一的非线性对流-反应系统的控制设计
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究多个对流-反应方程与一个反应方程分布式耦合的非线性系统控制问题，其中输入与输出只施加在对流-反应子系统上。作者沿传输过程的共同特征线将整个耦合系统化简为单个带延迟的演化常微分方程，并据此设计基于逆（inversion-based）的前馈控制律，同时分析其性质如何取决于原系统的耦合结构：多数情形下输出相对阶为零，而相对阶为一的情形对实际应用尤为关键。为抑制不确定性与外部扰动，作者又在变换后的系统上引入带预测器的跟踪控制器，以补偿化简过程中产生的延迟。
innovations: 利用共同特征线把多个对流-反应方程加一个反应方程的分布式耦合系统化为单个带延迟的演化常微分方程，从而把无穷维控制设计降到低维表示上完成
提出基于逆的前馈控制律，并显式刻画其可行性如何随原系统的耦合结构变化，区分相对阶为零与相对阶为一两类情形，指出后者更具实用价值
在变换后系统上构造带预测器的跟踪控制器与逆前馈串联，专门补偿传输过程造成的延迟以及不确定性、扰动带来的跟踪偏差
papers.scenario_cn: 面向只能在对流-反应环节施加执行与测量的过程控制场景，如管式反应器、输送管网或多段换热过程中的浓度/温度跟踪控制；在这些场景中，测量与执行存在传输延迟，并且模型参数不精确，需要能够抵消延迟并抵抗扰动的控制律。
